    The format

    1. Teams play a ladder outside Court 1. The winners on Court 2 go on to face the 5.0’s.
    2. Players paddle down at Court 2. The ideal is 6 players: 2 challenging and 4 playing on Court 2.
    3. With more players, it depends on how busy the open play courts are:
      • if they are busy, players paddle down at Court 2;
      • if they are not busy, play moves to open play, with a ladder up to Court 2: winners from open play go to Court 2, and losers from Court 2 go down to open play.
    4. The 5.0’s stay on Court 1 and don’t leave.

    The stakes

    $10
